description: Per-chain validation + computational-trust audit per the QOU methodology directive: every numerical claim must trace back to first-principles axioms via a DerivationChain.

chain_results.target: β_D (deuteron canonical σ-word; total crossing count)
β_n (neutron canonical σ-word; total crossing count)
β_p (proton canonical σ-word; total crossing count)
bar-pairing binding observables B_arch(K) and B_bar(K): the archimedean and Hecke-bar lengths of the free-minus-bound character difference
chain_results.target_value: B_arch(K) = E_0 * sum_lambda y_lambda ( |chi^lambda(W_free)| - |chi^lambda(W_atom)| );  B_bar(K) = E_0 * sum_lambda y_lambda ( ||chi^lambda(W_free)||_bar - ||chi^lambda(W_atom)||_bar ),  ||chi||_bar = sqrt(chi(q_0) chi(q_0^{-1}))

chain_results.target: categorical per-partition binding energy B(K) = m_e * |sum_lambda y_lambda chi^lambda(beta_K) sgn(w_0^{S_{lambda'}}) f^lambda|, evaluated on the deuteron
per-Z isotope shard rows (layered framework predictions + AME 2020 reference)
chain_results.target_value: row(Z,N) = { layer L1: |tr_M(β_atom, q₀)| ; layer L2: B(nα) = n·B(⁴He) + C(n,2)·c_αα ; layer L4: M(A,Z) = N·m_n + Z·m_p − B(A,Z) } with AME 2020 reference attached

chain_results.target: canonical |tr_M(beta_atomic(Z,N))| at q_0 via the Frobenius pairing tr_M = sum_lambda y_lambda(q_0) chi^lambda(beta; q_0)
per-partition Hecke character chi^lambda(beta_atomic(Z,N); q_0) in the AVERAGED (colour-weighted) crossing convention
chain_results.target_value: chi^lambda(beta; q) = tr rho^lambda_Hoefsmit(beta) with each crossing carried as a colour-weighted pair (c, d) rather than a bare sign; evaluated at the substrate anchor q_0

chain_results.target: per-partition Hecke character chi^lambda(beta_atomic(Z,N); q_0) in the sign-only (Geck-Pfeiffer) crossing convention
chain_results.target_value: chi^lambda(beta; q) = tr rho^lambda_Hoefsmit(beta), for every lambda |- n, n = 3A; evaluated at the substrate anchor q_0

chain_results.target: Habiro / cyclotomic expansion of the mass-table trace: tr_M(K, q) = Σ_m a_m·(u;u)_m, u = q^{1/2}
chain_results.target_value: tr_M(K, q) = Σ_m a_m(u)·(u;u)_m with every a_m ∈ ℤ[u] (all_integral), reconstruction exact (reconstruction_matches), per canonical atom K = (Z, N)
ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_1) ∈ M_2(K(q)) — Hoefsmit matrix in the SYT basis {T_1=[1 2 / 3], T_2=[1 3 / 2]}
ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2) ∈ M_2(K(q)) — Hoefsmit matrix in the SYT basis {T_1=[1 2 / 3], T_2=[1 3 / 2]}; trace χ^(2,1)_q(σ_2) = q − q^{-1}

chain_results.target: production atomic Markov trace tr_M(beta_atom; q_0) for p, n, D, T, 3He, 4He via Markov-axiom recursive ascent on the Groebner-Shirshov normal form
chain_results.target_value: tr_M(beta_atom) computed symbolically in H_{3A}(q) by incremental GS reduction followed by recursive Markov-axiom descent, then evaluated at q_0; emitted at BOTH substrate pins as a deliberate comparison pair

chain_results.target: bar-fold symmetry-reduced bounded operator-selection LP per nucleus (primal + dual + strong-duality gap)
chain_results.target_value: on the positive-norm fold representatives: primal_obj = Σ_i t_i x_i*, dual_obj = n_target·y0*, duality_gap = |primal_obj − dual_obj| ≈ 0, with active_set = { i : y*_i > 0 }

chain_results.target: n=5 modular data (vacuum S-matrix row S_{0λ} and ribbon twist θ_λ)
chain_results.target_value: S_{0λ} = d_q(λ) / sqrt(Σ_μ d_q(μ)²)  and  θ_λ = q^{2c(λ)},  for every λ ⊢ 5
